question: A network engineer must configure a Cisco MDS switch to use the local user database for console access if all AAA servers are unreachable. Which configuration should be applied to complete this task?
options: aaa authentication login console fallback error local
aaa authentication login default fallback error local
theory: The console keyword scopes the fallback policy specifically to console line access rather than 'default', which would apply to all login paths (Telnet, SSH, DCNM, etc.). The command aaa authentication login console fallback error local ensures that only the console falls back to the local user database when all configured AAA servers are unreachable, leaving other access methods governed by whatever separate policy is configured for 'default'. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 20 - Local AAA Services, Console vs. Default Fallback)
